description: Header file defining interfaces for a temperature sensor management module, including an abstract implementation class (mfrImpl) with virtual functions, and a wrapper class (mfr) that provides static access to these functionalities.

classes.name: mfrImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for temperature sensor operations, including getting and setting temperature thresholds and retrieving temperature state.

classes.name: mfr
classes.description: Concrete class providing static methods to interact with the temperature sensor, holding a static implementation instance of mfrImpl.

methods.name: mfrImpl::mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Virtual function to retrieve high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: mfrImpl::mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Virtual function to set high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: mfrImpl::mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Virtual function to get current temperature state and measurements.

methods.name: mfr::mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Static method to retrieve current temperature thresholds.

methods.name: mfr::mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Static method to set temperature thresholds.

methods.name: mfr::mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Static method to get current temperature data.
